qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted regulated T&D utility franchise in New Jersey (PSE&G) combined with merchant nuclear generation protected by federal IRA Section 45U/45Y production tax credit price floors (~$43.75/MWh). Natural monopoly grid with formulaic FERC/NJ BPU cost recovery.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet & Cash Conversion, REJECT). Regulated New Jersey T&D utility and zero-carbon nuclear fleet benefiting from federal PTC price floors and successful divestiture of fossil generation. However, intensive infrastructure capex ($3.27B in FY2025) consumes virtually all operating cash flow ($3.30B), leaving zero organic cash to cover $1.26B in dividends and supporting $21.7B in long-term debt (10.3x net income) with thin 2.97x interest coverage.
qualitative.evidence: FY2025 revenue of $12.17B, EBIT of $2,980M, and net income of $2,111M. 10-year median GAAP ROIC is 6.70%. Balance sheet carries $21.67B in long-term debt against $132M cash, resulting in 10.3x debt/NI (threshold <=4.0x) and 2.97x interest coverage (EBIT $2,980M / Interest $1,005M, threshold >5.0x). Capex of $3,272M consumed entire OCF of $3,298M in FY2025.
